document.title: Launch readiness review
document.summary: A decision-focused account of release health, remaining risk, and the sequence that gets the team safely to launch.
document.provenance: Prepared from the release checklist, CI results, and owner interviews

blocks.title: Executive summary
blocks.html:
The release has cleared its required technical gates and has no open launch blocker. Two operational follow-ups remain: confirm the on-call handoff and publish the customer-facing change note.

The recommended decision is to proceed on the planned date, with both follow-ups assigned before the deployment window opens.

blocks.title: Decision
blocks.html: Proceed with the planned launch. Treat the on-call handoff and change note as pre-deploy conditions, not post-launch cleanup.

items.title: Confirm owners
items.detail: Release lead records the deployer, observer, and rollback owner.

items.title: Freeze release commit
items.detail: CI reruns against the exact commit intended for production.

items.title: Deploy and observe
items.detail: Deploy, run the critical smoke flow, and hold the observation window.
